occurrences.key: skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:107 — Discover and archive the actual direct-review package `final-review-ID.md.diff`. The collector discovers only `prefix+'.diff'`, while the real Workflow producer at skills/super-code/coordinator.js:2757 invokes review-package with `${reviewPath}.diff` and reviewPath is `final-review-ID.md`. A settled direct review can therefore return collection complete without preserving its input diff, allowing cleanup to destroy that source. The same incorrect suffix in hasBundle (:93) can classify a null/no-work return with a leftover actual direct package as artifact-free. Update discovery and null bundle detection to match the producer, and use producer-shaped .md.diff fixtures (tests/super-auto/test-scripts.sh:352 currently invents the shorter .diff filename). Retain byte-for-byte/idempotent archive assertions for that real filename.
